subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona-level TTS SecretRefs join the existing fail-closed startup contract immediately, or should landing wait for the optional-TTS degradation decision in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101204 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265?
rationale: This PR changes configured persona refs from ignored objects into active startup assignments; current behavior requires active refs to fail closed, while the related open work proposes a narrower fail-open boundary for optional TTS credentials.

options.title: Land under current contract
options.body: After the code repairs and exact-head consumer proof, merge this focused collection fix with existing fail-closed startup semantics and decide optional degradation separately.

options.title: Coordinate startup policy first
options.body: Pause landing until maintainers decide and, if accepted, land the optional-TTS degradation boundary so newly recognized missing persona refs cannot take down Gateway startup.

recommendation.title: Land under current contract
recommendation.body: After the code repairs and exact-head consumer proof, merge this focused collection fix with existing fail-closed startup semantics and decide optional degradation separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The original SecretRef collector and registry architecture plus related recent managed-secret work point most strongly to this owner for the secrets-runtime boundary.
